claims.claim: Web accessibility means designing and developing websites, tools, and technologies so people with disabilities can use them.
Browsers create an accessibility tree based on the DOM for platform accessibility APIs and assistive technologies.
Keyboard evaluation should check reachable controls, ability to move away, logical order, visible focus, and keyboard operation of required functionality.
Functional images need alternatives that communicate the action or destination, while decorative images can use empty alt text.
Accessibility depends on multiple components, including web technologies, user agents, authoring tools, and websites.
